summary: CapacityProfile defines the workflow for configuring, validating, and saving destination capacity profiles for placements (e.g., students in healthcare sites). It includes setup, discipline selection, placement info, scheduling, validations, and summary steps. It supports single/multiple subdisciplines, grouping codes, shift types (days, evenings, nights, others), maximum spaces per term, and group/non-group placement controls. Extensive business and validation rules govern placement eligibility, shift assignments, hours per week, and custom codes/comments.
purpose: To provide a comprehensive, step-driven interface for defining site/program capacity, allowable placements, shift schedules, maximum spaces, subdiscipline grouping, and rationale/comments, with robust business logic and validation ensuring accurate, compliant data entry and storage.

workflows.name: Capacity Profile Wizard
steps: Instructions: Show capacity wizard instructions, headings, notes.
Disciplines: Select discipline, subdisciplines, use same capacity for all, specify/group codes, actively seeking students, placement allowance (yes/no), reasons, comments.
Placement Information: Set minimum year, maximum spaces (winter/spring/fall), allowed shifts, accept consecutive placements, rationale/comments.
Schedule: Configure shift schedule per subdiscipline, per day/eve/night/other, hours/week, required checks.
Summary: Review entered data, confirm before saving profile.

workflows.name: Profile Save/Validate
steps: Validate discipline/subdiscipline selection and required fields.
Validate maximum spaces per term with numeric checks and required field validators.
Validate shift schedule: at least one day/eve/night/other checked, hours/week in allowed range (1-60), custom and range validators.
Validate grouping codes and request codes per discipline/subdiscipline.
Validate comments and reason codes, especially when placements not allowed or reason is 'Other'.

business_rules: Subdiscipline grouping is supported; SameCapacityForGroupingCode merges/group profiles.
Placement not allowed requires reason code and comments if 'Other'.
Maximum spaces fields are mandatory for each term and must be numeric.
Shift schedule: at least one day/eve/night/other must be selected per type; hours per week must be valid.
Consecutive placements option and comments required.
Permissions restrict editing by user role and agency context.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for discipline, max spaces, shift schedule.
RangeValidator: hours per week between 1 and 60.
CustomValidator: at least one shift box checked per type, hours required, reason required if placements not allowed.
CompareValidator: shifts other hours must be a number.
ValidationSummary per wizard step (disciplines, placementInformation, schedule).
Client-side JS validators for all step controls (e.g., scheduleCheckShiftRequiredDaysInd, scheduleCheckHoursRequired).
calculations: Total hours per week calculated from selected shift days multiplied by hours per day.
ShiftsOtherHours parsed from input, used for custom shift types.
RowSpan logic for UI: determines display rows per subdiscipline, grouping, comments, and consecutive placement.
conditions: If placement not allowed, must provide reason and comments.
If using same capacity for all subdisciplines, profile is merged.
If AcceptConsecutive is checked, show and require consecutive comments.
Show/Hide controls based on discipline/subdiscipline selection and user permissions.
Visibility of shift types and days depends on profile settings (SevenBy24 or specific days).
system_behavior: Wizard navigation: Next/Previous/Finish sidebars, client/server validation.
Data binding to repeaters and gridviews for schedule and placement info.
Dynamic UI response to discipline/subdiscipline/shift selections.
Auto-insert blank entry to dropdowns for flexibility.
Save and update profiles on finish/next, handling grouping logic.
dependencies: Codes.CodeSearch for capacity wizard instructions, reasons, student levels.
UserSession for permissions and agency filtering.
exceptions: If discipline or subdiscipline not specified: validation error.
If hours per week or max spaces not numeric or missing: validation error.
If placements not allowed and reason not specified: validation error.
If user lacks required role/permission: fields are read-only or editing blocked.
